poppy.name: Zhangqiu Coach
poppy.bio: One cue per swing. Meet it out front, then add speed.
poppy.whyExtra: Zhangqiu Coach would fix contact first this week — one cue, then repeat it.

cue.wrap: Zhangqiu Coach's cue: {cue}. One cue this week.
cue.contactBack: Zhangqiu Coach: meet it a racket-head farther in front. Power comes after contact.
cue.contactLate: Zhangqiu Coach: arrive earlier. The hit should be out in front, not late at the hip.
cue.contactLow: Zhangqiu Coach: wait for the peak. Low contact steals the finish.
cue.racketDropped: Zhangqiu Coach: keep the racket head up until the ball is gone.
cue.followShort: Zhangqiu Coach: finish over the shoulder. Don't cut the swing short.
cue.littleTurn: Zhangqiu Coach: turn the shoulders first. The hands follow.
cue.noTurn: Zhangqiu Coach: turn sideways first. Face-on contact stays late.
cue.feetLate: Zhangqiu Coach: set the feet, then swing. Don't hit on the run.
cue.swingBig: Zhangqiu Coach: block, don't take a big swing. Short path, firm face.

en.persona: You are 涨球教练, also called Zhangqiu Coach. Speak as a sideline coach. Give ONE contact-first cue per reply. Meet the ball out in front before adding power. Do not pile tips. Stay on the confirmed plan. You may sign a cue as 涨球教练.

poppy.name: 涨球教练
poppy.bio: 一次一条提示。先在身前打到球，再加力量。
poppy.whyExtra: 涨球教练这周会先改正击球点——只留一个提示，反复练。

cue.wrap: 涨球教练的提示：{cue}。这周只练这一条。
cue.contactBack: 涨球教练：再往身前送一个拍头。力量放在击球之后。
cue.contactLate: 涨球教练：再早一点到位。球要在身前打，不要拖到髋边。
cue.contactLow: 涨球教练：等到最高点。击球偏低会吃掉随挥。
cue.racketDropped: 涨球教练：球走之前拍头不要掉。
cue.followShort: 涨球教练：随挥收到肩上，不要中途截住。
cue.littleTurn: 涨球教练：先转肩，手再跟上来。
cue.noTurn: 涨球教练：先侧身。正对来球一定偏晚。
cue.feetLate: 涨球教练：脚站稳再挥，不要边跑边打。
cue.swingBig: 涨球教练：挡，不要大挥。路线短，拍面稳。
